international.title: ‘A source of inspiration’: California celebrates the late civil rights icon Dolores Huerta
international.summary: A public vigil and celebration of life honor the civil rights activist and co-founder of United Farm Workers union Hundreds of people came out to honor and celebrate the life and legacy of the California civil rights activist Dolores Huerta at a celebration-of-life event Friday in Bakersfield. Huerta’s daughter Lori de Leon thanked attendees for their support during her mother’s passing, highlighting the widespread tributes and communities gathering in her honor. Continue reading...

international.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
international.summary: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.
